## Summary

Rebuilds ADR 0156 from current main after ADR 0155 landed. Adds additive ADR 0142 campaign execution identity, deterministic campaign planning, controlled machine-local fixtures, exact preflight and bounded failure semantics, and separates physical GGUF representation identity from Windows-native/WSL2 runtime identity so runtime characterization cannot be mistaken for a model-only comparison.

This is the first current-main implementation slice; managed acquisition, campaign worker execution, UI completion, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation continue on this Draft PR.
